# Troubleshooting

The things that go wrong most often, and what to do about them.

## The sign-in code never arrives

Check the address you typed against the one your invitation was sent to. They
have to match, because Fernwell Ledger sends the code to the invited address
and nowhere else.

If they match, look in your spam folder, then ask for another code. Codes
expire after ten minutes.

## You sign in and land in the wrong workspace

One email address can belong to several workspaces. Choose **Switch workspace**
from the menu under your name.

## Quickcast shows nothing

Quickcast needs a quarter of invoices before it has anything to say. A
workspace younger than that shows an empty panel, and nothing is wrong.

## An invoice you sent has the wrong amount

A sent invoice cannot be edited. Credit it, which leaves both documents in the
record, and send a new one. Your client sees both.

## An export is missing rows

An export covers the date range you picked, by invoice date rather than by
payment date. Widen the range and export again.

## Nothing here matches

Write to support from **Help → Contact us**, and say what you were doing when
it went wrong. Include the invoice number if there is one.
